title: Power of entry into building, etc

versions.Latest:
91. Power of entry into building, etc.—

—   Where   infectious   disease   exists,   the 
Secretary or any person authorized by the Panchayat in this behalf may enter at any time 
after reasonable notice, any building or premises in which any infectious disease is 
reported or suspected to exist, for the purpose of inspecting such building or premises. No 
such inspection shall be made except between sunrise and sunset.
